value.rationale: The recently proved qualitative detection of noncommutativity leaves open the size and axes of the strongest geometric obstruction. This result supplies a complete basis-free exact invariant for all planar covariance/generator pairs, a sharp sum-of-squares angular stability profile, and the precise set and angular measure of violating rectangles. The continuous exact classification makes quantitative comparison of Gaussian anisotropy possible and is not an arbitrary numerical slice or a recomputation of the published one-instance table.
